description: Raw rows and guards retained from the CPython/JavaScriptCore Lizard tokenizer diagnosis. Each child object preserves its execution-time protocol.

bunRawScanner.protocol: all variants raw-scan the exact current TypeScriptReader combined source-aligned pattern; all validate identical raw token text+UTF-16 start digest. Each variant warmed once, then three cyclic orders.

bunFirstExecutionObservations.protocol: fresh Bun process; no scanner warmup before firstReused; then same operation; then per-file new operation twice. This cannot force JSC internal compiled-regexp cache eviction, so it measures first execution in this process, not a proven compilation-only delta.

pythonRawScanner.protocol: Python raw upstream-pattern scan on same decoded 254-file request. All variants are semantically identical in Python. Guard hashes text plus converted UTF-16 start offsets, outside timing. re.finditer(pattern string, flags) and re.compile(pattern,flags) use CPython re cache after initial compile; compiledFinditer is explicit reuse.

bunFeatureAblation.protocol: Feature ablations execute exact same corpus via fresh gmsu RegExp+exec/file after one warmup each. Except current, variants intentionally change token semantics and often match count; they are diagnostic cost probes only, NOT candidate implementations or parity evidence.

pythonFeatureAblation.protocol: CPython raw pattern ablation; same decoded request; variants except current deliberately alter regex semantics. Guard hashes text plus converted UTF-16 start and is excluded from timing. One warmup/variant then 8 cyclic orders.

bunGenericStageControl.protocol: Bun exact-output stage control. Both conditions guard identical raw text+UTF-16 starts. staged runs the generic branch only when scanner position is < and otherwise uses a sticky no-generic main regex. This is a diagnostic control, not a proposed replacement.

pythonGenericStageControl.protocol: CPython exact-output stage control: generic regex invoked only at scanner position <; otherwise no-generic main uses re.match at current position. Same guard is text+converted UTF-16 start. Diagnostic control only.

bunGeneratorControl.protocol: Same decoded corpus. Timed operation drains the actual generators and counts yielded tokens only; SHA guards are preflight and excluded. This measures CodeReader generator + TokenMatch + macro logic versus TypeScript wrapper/template split. It does not include reader state-machine processors.

bunFeatureOutputGuards.protocol: Untimed Bun output guard for current, no-generic, and ASCII-word variants on the same decoded corpus.

bun.protocol: new exact current RegExp/file + exec; guard preflight hashes raw text+UTF16 start but is excluded; countOnly does only loop counter; fields does m[0].length + m.index.

python.protocol: compiled upstream pattern + finditer; guard preflight hashes raw text+convertedUTF16 start but excluded; countOnly loop counter; fields len(m.group())+m.start().

python314SupportingObservation.protocol: compiled upstream pattern + finditer; guard preflight hashes raw text+convertedUTF16 start but excluded; countOnly loop counter; fields len(m.group())+m.start().

bunSyntheticControls.protocol: Synthetic diagnostic only: preserve 254-file lengths/total UTF-16 char count, but not real-language semantics. noLt has zero <; manyLtFail contains repeated < but no ? or >, so generic lookahead cannot succeed. New RegExp+exec/file, one warm/pattern, then 12 alternating pairs.

jscDiagnosticAttempt.description: JSC_dumpRegExpDisassembly/JSC_traceRegExpJITExecution produced no engine diagnostic output for true, 1, false, or 0. JSC_useRegExpJIT true/false timing overlapped across forward/reverse process order and the setting could not be audited; no conclusion about actual JIT or bytecode execution is supported.
